rationale: Public NanoVDB velocity values are float32.
Unoccluded deep-interior velocity is approximately 8.8 to 9.1 m/s.
Phase 6EM P4 recorded a deep maximum of 1.5913658e-5 m/s and a center maximum of 1.0030950e-5 m/s.
The new 1e-4 m/s hard maximum is 0.1 percent of the minimum 0.1 m/s OFF positive control and is stricter than the existing 1 percent relative gate.
The tolerance covers small float32 residuals after rotation, grid phasing, and interpolation.
This is a new qualification contract and does not revise or reinterpret the failed historical contract.

P1_y40.stale_transform_mode: where identity-only OFF maximum reaches 0.1 m/s, ON/OFF ratio must remain at least 0.1 so suppression is not stale at identity

P2_roll_x17.stale_transform_mode: identity-only comparison may be geometrically sparse because the long axis is unchanged; report availability and require exact matrix parity plus current-pose gates

scope: Flow 110.0.0, current fixed resolution, current 26-vertex closed Mesh, and only P0-P5 representative static single-axis/compound poses under the Phase 6EN engineering tolerance; not all SO(3), dynamic transform, RenderSurface, PhysX sharing, production layout, or 20-log performance.
